components.name: Cascader
components.description: Pick a path through nested options, column by column (one column at a time on small screens).

props.name: expandTrigger
props.description: "click" (default) or "hover" opens the next column.

props.name: displayRender
props.description: Trigger text for a path (default: labels joined with `separator`).

props.name: showSearch
props.description: Search over whole paths, listed flat ("Hà Nội / Ba Đình").

props.name: loadData
props.description: Load an option's children when it is opened (set them in `options`).

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Show an × to clear the value (default true).

props.name: maxTagCount
props.description: Chips shown before "+N" (multiple, default 3).

props.name: multiple
props.description: Checkboxes on every level; parents are tri-state.

props.name: changeOnSelect
props.description: Pick a non-leaf option too (every click on a parent sets the value).

props.name: value
props.description: A path of values, e.g. ["hn", "ba-dinh"].

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: ((value: string[], selectedOptions: CascaderOption[]) => void) | ((value: string[][], selectedOptions: CascaderOption[][]) => void)

props.name: showCheckedStrategy
props.description: Which checked paths form the value: "parent" (default), "child" (leaves) or "all".

components.name: CheckboxGroup
components.description: A list of checkboxes with an optional tri-state "select all".

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected values.

props.name: separator
props.description:
Emit the values joined into one string (e.g. "," → "email,sms")
instead of an array; `value` is then split the same way.

props.name: selectAll
props.description:
Adds a "select all" checkbox on top (pass a label, or `true` for
"Select all"). It shows a dash when only some options are selected.

components.name: Collapse
components.description: Panels that expand and collapse: a list (`items`) on the shadcn Accordion.

props.name: variant
props.description: "bordered" (one box, default), "separated" (a card per panel) or "ghost" (no borders).

props.name: expandIcon
props.description: Chevron (default) or a +/− box.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: "header": the whole row toggles (default); "icon": only the icon does.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keep closed panels in the DOM (e.g. to preserve form state).

props.name: accordion
props.description: Only one panel open at a time.

components.name: Combobox
components.description: Searchable select, single or `multiple` (chips), on a Popover.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Search box on top of the list (default true).

props.name: onSearch
props.description: Server-side search: called with the query, and the list is shown unfiltered.

props.name: loading
props.description: Spinner in the list while `onSearch` results load.

props.name: maxCount
props.description: Most options that can be selected (multiple).

props.name: maxTagCount
props.description: Chips shown in the trigger before "+N" (multiple, default 3).

props.name: tagMode
props.description: "chips" (default) or "count" ("3 selected") in the trigger.

props.name: showSelectAll
props.description: A "Select all" row on top (multiple).

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close after picking (default: true for single, false for multiple).

props.name: creatable
props.description: Offer to add the typed text as a new option.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show an × to clear the value (default true).

props.name: ref
props.description: The trigger (react-hook-form focuses it on a validation error).

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.description:
Asks before a destructive or important action (on the shadcn AlertDialog).
Open it from `trigger`, or control it with `open` / `onOpenChange`.
`onConfirm` may be async: a spinner shows until it settles.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the dialog, e.g. a `<Button>`. Omit when controlling `open`.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state (e.g. opened from a menu item).

props.name: onConfirm
props.description:
May return a promise: the dialog stays open with a spinner until it
settles, and stays open (for a retry) if it rejects.

components.name: DataTable
components.description:
Data table on top of TanStack Table: search, sort, filters, row actions,
selection, sticky header with a body-only scrollbar, and pagination.

Every piece of state (search, sorting, filters, pagination) works out of
the box, or can be controlled from outside and combined with the
`manual*` flags to let a server do the work.

props.name: getRowId
props.description: Stable row id (e.g. `(row) => row.id`); needed for row selection across pages and `rowSelection`.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Shows skeleton rows in the body while keeping the header.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no rows, e.g. an `<EmptyState />`.

props.name: onRowClick
props.description: Click anywhere on a row (clicks on buttons, links and checkboxes are ignored).

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Shows the search box.

props.name: searchColumns
props.description: Only search these column ids (default: every text/number column).

props.name: searchValue
props.description: Controlled search text, e.g. to query an API.

props.name: manualSorting
props.description: Rows arrive already sorted (server-side).

props.name: enableMultiSort
props.description: Shift + click to sort by several columns.

props.name: manualFiltering
props.description: Rows arrive already filtered / searched (server-side).

props.name: rowActions
props.description: Adds an actions column at the end.

props.name: rowActionsDisplay
props.description:
Default placement of the actions: all inside a "…" menu, or each as its
own button. A single action can override it with `display`.

props.name: actionsColumnSize
props.description: Width of the actions column in px (default: estimated from the actions).

props.name: actionsColumnPinned
props.description:
When the columns don't fit and the table scrolls horizontally, keep the
actions column fixed on the right. When everything fits it is a normal column.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Vertical borders between cells (reads better with grouped headers and merged rows).

props.name: maxBodyHeight
props.description: Body scrolls inside this height (number = px). The scrollbar stays inside the body.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: With `maxBodyHeight`: keep the header fixed above the scrolling body.

props.name: manualPagination
props.description: Rows arrive already paginated (server-side); pass `rowCount` too.

props.name: rowCount
props.description: Total rows on the server when `manualPagination`.

props.name: toolbarActions
props.description: Controls on the right of the toolbar, e.g. an "Add" button.

props.name: enableRowSelection
props.description: Adds a checkbox column. Pass a function to decide per row.

props.name: selectionType
props.description: "checkbox" (default) or "radio" (one row at a time).

props.name: selectAllMode
props.description: Header checkbox: the current page ("page", default) or every filtered row ("all").

props.name: selectionColumnPinned
props.description: When the table scrolls horizontally, keep the checkbox column fixed on the left.

props.name: rowSelection
props.description: Controlled selection: row ids from `getRowId` (kept across pages, also server-side).

props.name: onRowSelectionChange
props.description: Selected rows (those loaded) and the ids of every selected row.

props.name: bulkActions
props.description: Toolbar content while rows are selected (delete, export...).

props.name: grouping
props.description: Group rows by these column ids, nested in this order.

props.name: enableGrouping
props.description: "Group by" menu in the toolbar (columns with an accessor and `enableGrouping !== false`).

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Groups start expanded (default true).

props.name: paginateGroups
props.description: Paginate over top-level groups instead of every visible row.

props.name: renderGroupRow
props.description: Label of a group row (default "Column: value"); the count is added after it.

props.name: keepGroupedColumns
props.description: Keep grouped columns as normal columns (default: hidden, their value is in the group row).

components.name: DataTableColumnHeader
components.description: Sortable header: click cycles asc → desc → none.

components.name: sortableHeader
components.description: Column `header` renderer with a sort toggle: `header: sortableHeader("Name")`.

components.name: DataTableFilterControl
components.description: One toolbar filter button; its UI depends on `filter.type`.

components.name: DataTablePagination
components.description:
DataTable footer: row (or selected) count, rows-per-page select and page
buttons. DataTable renders it; use it directly only around your own TanStack table.

props.name: showSelectedCount
props.description: Show "n of total selected" instead of the row count.

props.name: selectedCount
props.description: Selected rows (default: the keys of the selection state).

components.name: DataTableRowActions
components.description: The actions cell: inline buttons and/or a "…" menu for one row.

props.name: display
props.description: Default placement for actions without their own `display`.

components.name: DataTableToolbar
components.description:
DataTable header: search, filters, Reset, Group and View menus, extra
actions; bulk actions replace it while rows are selected. DataTable renders
it; use it directly only around your own TanStack table.

props.name: bulkActions
props.description: Rendered instead of the filters while rows are selected.

props.name: enableGrouping
props.description: "Group by" menu for the groupable columns.

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: Pick a day from a calendar in a popover (react-day-picker).

props.name: minDate
props.description: Earliest / latest selectable moment (whole days for the calendar, the time on their own day).

props.name: disabledDates
props.description: Days that can't be picked: a list, or a test such as `(d) => d.getDay() === 0`.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for the displayed value and the first day of the week (default "en-GB").

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show an × to clear the value.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description:

a pattern like "yyyy-MM-dd", or a `{ format, parse }` codec.

props.name: displayFormat
props.description: Pattern for the shown text, e.g. "dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm" (default: the locale's format).

props.name: editable
props.description: Let the user type the value (masked to `displayFormat`, default "dd/MM/yyyy[ HH:mm]").

props.name: timeZone
props.description:
IANA time zone the user picks in, e.g. "Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh" (default: the
browser's). Dates / ISO / timestamps stay instants; patterns are wall time there.

components.name: FormField
components.description:
Connects any control to react-hook-form and renders label, description
and error with the shadcn `Field` primitives. FormInput, FormSelect, ...
are thin wrappers around this, so build new form controls here too.

components.name: FormInput
components.description:
Text input field: label, description and error built in. Other props
(type, placeholder, maxLength for the counter...) go to the Input.

props.name: showCount
props.description:
Show "12/100" at the end of the field. Defaults to true when
`maxLength` or `minLength` is set.

components.name: FormRate
components.description: Star rating field; the form value is a number (0 = not rated).

props.name: count
props.description: Number of stars (default 5).

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Clicking the current value again resets to 0 (default true).

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Show the score only (no hover / click / keyboard).

props.name: allowHalf
props.description: Pick half stars (click the left half).

props.name: character
props.description: Icon component (default Star) or any node ("A", "♥").

props.name: renderCharacter
props.description: A different character per star, e.g. faces for 1–5.

props.name: tooltips
props.description: Tooltip per star, e.g. ["Bad", "Poor", "OK", "Good", "Great"].

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the number ("3.5") after the stars.

props.name: onHoverChange
props.description: Hovered value (undefined when the pointer leaves).

components.name: FormSelect
components.description: Select field: the shadcn Select, or a Combobox when `multiple` / `searchable`.

props.description: Show an × to clear the value (default true).

props.name: searchable

Show "12/500" in the bottom-right corner. Defaults to true when

props.description: Titles of the two lists (default "Source", "Target").

props.description: Search box on top of the tree.

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Show an × to clear the value (default true).

props.name: maxTagCount
props.description: Chips shown before "+N" (multiple, default 3).

props.name: dropdownHeight
props.description: Height of the tree inside the dropdown (default "18rem").

props.name: treeCheckable
props.description: Pick with checkboxes (implies multiple).

components.name: PageHeader
components.description: Page title with an optional description and right-aligned actions; stacks on small screens.

props.name: actions
props.description: Right-aligned actions, e.g. primary button.

components.name: TimeColumns
components.description: Scrollable hour / minute (/ second / AM-PM) columns, as tall as their container.

props.name: value
props.description: Picked time in seconds since midnight; undefined = nothing picked yet.

props.name: bounds
props.description: Allowed window (other options are disabled).

props.name: title
props.description: Small heading on top, e.g. "Start".

components.name: ProgressBar
components.description: Progress with a label, the value ("42%") and an optional description.

props.name: value
props.description: 0–`max` (default 100).

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Unknown progress: a bar sliding back and forth.

props.name: description
props.description: Small text under the bar, e.g. "3 of 12 files".

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the value on the right of the label (default: true unless indeterminate).

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Text for the value; default "42%".

props.name: type
props.description: "line" (default) or "circle" (ProgressCircle with the label underneath).

props.name: gapDegree
props.description: Circle only: degrees left open at the bottom (gauge).

components.name: ProgressCircle
components.description: Circular progress (SVG ring), optionally a gauge with a gap at the bottom.

props.name: value
props.description: 0–`max` (default 100).

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Unknown progress: a spinning arc.

props.name: size
props.description: sm 40px / default 64px / lg 96px, or a number of px.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Ring thickness in px (default 4 / 6 / 8 by size).

props.name: gapDegree
props.description: Degrees left open at the bottom, e.g. 75 for a "dashboard" gauge.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the value in the middle (default: true unless indeterminate).

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Text for the value; default "42%".

props.name: children
props.description: Custom content in the middle (instead of the value).

components.name: Rate
components.description: Star rating with half stars, custom characters and tooltips; ← → / Home / End on the keyboard.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of stars (default 5).

props.name: allowHalf
props.description: Pick half stars (click the left half).

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Clicking the current value again resets to 0 (default true).

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Show the score only (no hover / click / keyboard).

props.name: character
props.description: Icon component (default Star) or any node ("A", "♥").

props.name: renderCharacter
props.description: A different character per star, e.g. faces for 1–5.

props.name: tooltips
props.description: Tooltip per star, e.g. ["Bad", "Poor", "OK", "Good", "Great"].

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the number ("3.5") after the stars.

props.name: onHoverChange
props.description: Hovered value (undefined when the pointer leaves).

components.name: Stepper
components.description: Progress through a multi-step flow (checkout, onboarding, wizard).

props.name: current
props.description: Index of the current step; earlier steps are complete.

props.name: onStepClick
props.description: Makes steps clickable: completed ones, or all with `allowJumpAhead`.

components.name: ThemeToggle
components.description: Light / dark / system menu on an icon button (next-themes). Already in AppHeader.

components.name: Transfer
components.description: Two lists side by side: tick items and move them across (on small screens they stack).

props.name: targetKeys
props.description: Keys in the right-hand list (the value, e.g. of a form field).

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: ((targetKeys: string[], direction: TransferDirection, movedKeys: string[]) => void)

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description: Ticked items on both sides (controlled); default: managed inside.

props.name: titles
props.description: Titles of the two lists (default "Source", "Target").

props.name: filterOption
props.description: Custom match for the search (default: title / description, accent-insensitive).

props.name: showSelectAll
props.description: Tri-state "select all" in each list header (default true).

props.name: oneWay
props.description: Only move to the right; items on the right have an × to remove them.

props.name: listHeight
props.description: Height of each list's scrolling area (default "18rem").

props.name: operations
props.description: Texts for the move buttons (default: arrow icons only).

props.name: footer
props.description: Under each list, e.g. a "Reload" button.

props.name: ref
props.description: The first list (react-hook-form focuses it on a validation error).

components.name: Tree
components.description: Tree with expand / select / check (tri-state), drag and drop, lazy loading and search.

props.name: expandIcon
props.description: "chevron" (default) or a +/− box.

props.name: showLine
props.description: Guide lines between parents and children.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Click selects a node (default true).

props.name: checkable
props.description: Checkboxes; a parent shows a dash when only some children are checked.

props.name: checkStrictly
props.description: Parent and children are checked independently.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Drag nodes to reorder / re-parent them (all, or a test per node).

props.name: allowDrop
props.type: ((info: { dragNode: TreeNode; dropNode: TreeNode; position: DropPosition; }) => boolean)

props.name: loadData
props.description: Load children when a node without them is expanded (set them in `treeData`).

props.name: searchValue
props.description: Filter: matching nodes and their parents stay visible, the parents open.

props.name: height
props.description: Scroll inside this height (number = px).

components.name: TreeSelect
components.description: Dropdown field with a Tree inside: one node, several, or checkboxes with a parent / child strategy.

props.name: showSearch
props.description: Search box on top of the tree.

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Show an × to clear the value (default true).

props.name: maxTagCount
props.description: Chips shown before "+N" (multiple, default 3).

props.name: dropdownHeight
props.description: Height of the tree inside the dropdown (default "18rem").

props.name: multiple
props.description: Pick several nodes by clicking them.

props.name: treeCheckable
props.description: Pick with checkboxes (implies multiple).

props.name: showCheckedStrategy
props.description:
With treeCheckable, which checked keys form the value: "all" (default),
"parent" (a fully checked parent stands for its children) or "child" (leaves only).

components.name: TruncatedText
components.description:
Text that is cut with an ellipsis when it doesn't fit, with the full text
in a tooltip on hover (needs `TruncateTooltipProvider` at the root).
The parent must bound the width: e.g. a table cell, `w-48`, or `min-w-0`
inside a flex row.

props.name: lines
props.description: 1 = single line with an ellipsis; 2–6 = cut after that many lines.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Show the full text in a tooltip on hover when it is cut off.

components.name: TruncateTooltipProvider
components.description:
One tooltip for the whole app: when the pointer rests on an element with
`data-truncate` whose text is actually cut off, show its full text above
it (below near the top edge). Mount once at the root (providers.tsx).

components.name: AppHeader
components.description: Sticky top bar: sidebar toggle, current page title from `siteConfig.nav`, theme toggle. Part of AppShell.

components.name: AppShell
components.description: Sidebar + sticky header + content area. Used by app/(app)/layout.tsx.

components.name: AppSidebar
components.description:
Sidebar built from `siteConfig` (config/site.ts): app name, nav groups,
active item from the URL; collapses to icons. Part of AppShell.
